name: Diagnose a numeric parser that silently accepts garbage
prompt: Run the project's tests, diagnose the failure across src/, fix the implementation, and verify that all tests pass. src/parse.js parseNumber() uses a base-10 integer parser, so it truncates decimals and mangles 0x-prefixed hex literals, and it returns NaN instead of rejecting empty or non-numeric input. Fix parseNumber() so it accepts decimal and 0x/0b literal strings (returning a number), and throws a TypeError for empty, whitespace-only, or non-numeric input.
